'''Jorin Arene''' is a merchant in [[Amador]]. He is a [[Darkfriend]]. He has a wife named [[Amellia Arene]], who is also a Darkfriend.

== Activities ==
He objected to [[Liandrin]] and the rest of her [[Black Ajah]] group taking over his house, so Liandrin allowed [[Temaile Kinderode]] to torture him into submission.{{ref/book|5|18}}
